method: Compared JSON Schema Validation 2020-12 and Anthropic Define tools docs with the lesson; ran the SHA-pinned offline verifier under Python 3.10 and Pydantic 2.9.2. The verifier executes both Python examples, checks exact published stdout, exercises fake tool-call success/failure, provenance boundaries, date/enum claims, and approval policy edge cases. No provider/network calls.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 model outputs and arithmetic runs lack per-request raw traces, model snapshot and scorer, so they remain historical summaries and were not reproduced.
The fake client checks local control flow and constructed schema only; no live provider, production database, authorization boundary, or tool-choice support was tested.
The provenance fields are application-generated metadata and do not prove source integrity, freshness, or authorization.
The approval threshold is a constructed demonstration, not a recommended financial or business policy.
